task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the light gray cylindrical trashbin up, pour all balls inside bin
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将浅灰色圆柱形垃圾桶拾起，将垃圾桶内的所有球倒出
